quarterly_data.quarter: MEC press release: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Noncurrent Assets (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MEC's board resolved to acquire land and buildings adjacent to its Nagaoka Factory (Nagaoka City, Niigata Prefecture), its mass-production factory in Japan, for approx. JPY 2.3 billion from own funds (planned); contract dated September 30, 2026, property handover March 31, 2027. The company says the Nagaoka Factory will mark 40 years of operation in 2033 and is expected to undergo major upgrades, and the land expands its options for renovating the factory, as part of strengthening its group-wide supply structure for expanding AI-driven demand for electronic substrates and components. MEC states it has a particularly high market share in chemicals for the package-substrate manufacturing process. Impact on results for the fiscal year ending December 2026 is described as immaterial.
quarterly_data.figure: Approx. JPY 2.3 billion (land and buildings); handover March 31, 2027
